name: Arcane Gate

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

targets.description: two points on the ground you can see, one within 10 feet of you

summary: Open two linked portals within range; stepping into one brings you out of the other.
text: Each portal is a 10-foot-diameter ring on a surface or in the air, usable only from one side you choose. As a Bonus Action you can turn which side each faces.
